budgetPolicy.source: Fresh verified available native USDC balance, excluding existing reservations
budgetPolicy.calculation: floor(available native atomic units * 95 / 100 / 1e12) in ERC-20 USDC atomic units
budgetPolicy.gas: Remaining 5% must cover all approvals and swap gas. Stop before signing if insufficient; do not exceed the requested 95% trade budget.
